defects_found_and_repaired.summary: Isolation scan produced a false failure by treating a test fixture as runtime coupling
defects_found_and_repaired.root_cause: browser-engine/tests/skiptrace-integrity.test.js:47 reads src/pages/StrategicReport.jsx as a fixture and asserts it contains 'base44.entities.SkipTrace.filter('
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Scan now distinguishes runtime coupling from test fixtures; added an explicit assertion that the four service entry points import nothing from the platform

defects_found_and_repaired.summary: Module type was implicit for the shared layer
defects_found_and_repaired.root_cause: root shared/ had no package.json, so ESM resolution depended on ambient detection

defects_found_and_repaired.summary: The environment template was silently excluded from the committed core
defects_found_and_repaired.root_cause: .gitignore carried '.env' and '.env.*' with no negation, so env.example was ignored and is absent from commit 9ca7be3
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: added a negation for env.example to .gitignore; the template is now committable

defects_found_and_repaired.summary: The engine's route prefix was recorded as unverified and is now confirmed correct
defects_found_and_repaired.root_cause: no evidence had been gathered for which prefix the engine serves
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: confirmed the engine mounts its router at '/' and '/engine' and serves no /v1 routes, so the gateway's unprefixed calls need no change

security_findings.finding: browser-engine/server.js generates session share tokens with Math.random().toString(36).slice(2), which is not a cryptographically secure generator
security_findings.status: REPORTED — not repaired (engine was intentionally left untouched to avoid triggering a production deploy)

security_findings.finding: the engine exposes no tenant field on sessions, so tenant isolation for sessions depends entirely on the new gateway session_owners table; a session created by calling the engine directly is denied by the gateway (fail-closed)
security_findings.status: MITIGATED by design — documented in db/migrations/001_portable_core.sql

security_findings.finding: API rate limiting is in-process, therefore per replica rather than global
security_findings.status: ACCEPTED LIMITATION — requires a shared store to fix

security_findings.finding: api/, worker/ and browser-engine/ ship no committed lockfiles. browser-engine is the worst case: it is deployed and depends on express, playwright, ws and @supabase/supabase-js, so its builds are not reproducible. shared/ declares no dependencies and needs none; python-sdk/ is not deployed
security_findings.status: OPEN — requires npm install --package-lock-only in each of the three directories

security_findings.finding: the environment template could not be inspected: the platform blocks reads of env-pattern paths from both bash and the file tools, so whether it lists variable NAMES only, or also carries values, is UNVERIFIED
security_findings.status: OPEN — a human or the external operator must confirm it holds names only before it is committed

blockers: Railway blast radius: commit 9ca7be3 reached main, so every service that auto-deploys on main without watch paths was triggered by it. Only cloudbrowser-engine has a safe watch path identified so far (browser-engine/**). cloudbrowser-control-staging cannot be scoped until its Root Directory and Dockerfile path are known.

Railway / Vercel / Supabase: no staging deployment attempted. No repository-connected staging target was verified, and modifying production services, secrets, schemas or DNS requires explicit approval.
Lockfiles: cannot be generated in this environment (no registry install of express/pg/playwright performed).
Independent validation (Guardian): NO independent validator executed. Marked BLOCKED rather than self-certified.
Frontend port: 145 files still import the platform client. Not attempted in this batch.
Data/function port: 108 of 113 entity schemas and 207 of 207 backend functions are unported.
Operator plugin / skills package: not created; no ChatGPT plugin installation is possible from this environment.

Partly closed: the engine mounts its router at both '/' and '/engine' (browser-engine/server.js:1408-1409) and serves no /v1 routes, so the gateway's unprefixed '/sessions' and '/health' calls are correct. Still unverified: the single-session GET response BODY shape, so the gateway accepts either a bare session object or a { session } envelope. Read browser-engine/server.js:1061 and tighten.
No downloadable source archive: this environment exposes repository files, not a packaged zip.

Unverified environment template: .gitignore has been changed to allow the env template through, but its contents could not be read with the available tools (env-pattern paths are blocked). Confirm it lists variable names only before it is committed. See security finding S5.
cloudbrowser-control-staging cannot be given a watch path until its Root Directory and Dockerfile path are known; scoping it incorrectly would silently stop its deploys.
next_action: Confirm the Railway watch-path / branch policy for the repository, then commit the portable core and generate api/ and worker/ lockfiles. After that, port the first vertical slice of the frontend off @/api/base44Client.
